title.original: APIGen-MT: Agentic Pipeline for Multi-Turn Data Generation via Simulated Agent-Human Interplay
title.zh: APIGen-MT：通过模拟智能体—人类交互生成多轮数据的智能体流水线
title.en: APIGen-MT: Agentic Pipeline for Multi-Turn Data Generation via Simulated Agent-Human Interplay

inclusion_reason.zh: APIGen-MT 的蓝图生成、委员会验证和双角色模拟组成可复用的多轮 Agent 数据生产与轨迹校验流水线。
inclusion_reason.en: APIGen-MT combines blueprint generation, committee verification, and two-role simulation into reusable infrastructure for producing and validating multi-turn agent trajectories.

abstract.zh: APIGen-MT 是生成可验证、多样化多轮 Agent 训练轨迹的两阶段流水线。第一阶段由 Agent 生成带真实动作的任务蓝图并经 LLM 委员会迭代审核，第二阶段通过模拟人类—Agent 互动把蓝图展开为完整对话和工具轨迹。
abstract.en: APIGen-MT is a two-phase pipeline for generating diverse, verifiable multi-turn agent trajectories. Agents first create task blueprints with ground-truth actions under iterative LLM-committee review, then simulated human–agent interaction expands each blueprint into a complete trajectory.

problem.zh: 真实多轮人机数据昂贵且稀缺，简单自生成又缺少可验证的动作序列和稳定的人类反馈动态，难以训练可靠工具 Agent。
problem.en: Real multi-turn interaction data is scarce and expensive, while naive self-generation lacks verifiable action sequences and realistic feedback dynamics needed for reliable tool agents.

approach.zh: 流水线先生成任务目标、API 调用和预期状态组成的蓝图，用多审阅者反馈修正，再由模拟用户和 Agent 按蓝图执行并记录每轮决策。
approach.en: The pipeline specifies goals, API actions, and expected states in a blueprint, repairs it through multiple reviewers, and has simulated users and agents execute it while recording each turn.

system_design.zh: 编排器连接蓝图生成器、LLM 审核委员会、反馈循环和双角色模拟器；真实动作作为控制面约束，使最终轨迹可自动检查而不是只依赖自然语言评分。
system_design.en: An orchestrator connects blueprint generation, an LLM review committee, iterative feedback, and a two-role simulator. Ground-truth actions constrain control flow so trajectories can be checked rather than judged only from prose.

key_results.zh: 由该数据训练的 xLAM-2-fc-r 系列在多轮工具基准上被报告优于多种前沿模型，且较小模型在部分设置中超过更大模型；团队开放了轨迹与模型。
key_results.en: Models trained on the generated data are reported to outperform several frontier systems on multi-turn tool benchmarks, with smaller variants sometimes beating larger ones; trajectories and models are released.

limitations.zh: 质量仍受蓝图生成模型、审阅者共识和模拟用户真实性限制；可验证动作不保证自然语言行为无偏，也未替代真实用户分布验证。
limitations.en: Quality remains bounded by blueprint models, reviewer agreement, and simulator realism; verifiable actions do not ensure unbiased language behavior or coverage of real user distributions.

notes.zh: 模型规模、两项基准和前沿模型基线来自官方摘要；硬件、各模型得分、试验重复与一致性数值待全文审计。
notes.en: Model range, two benchmarks, and frontier-model baselines come from the official abstract; hardware, per-model scores, repetitions, and consistency values await full-text audit.
